'''Mistress Thane''' is a member of the [[Women's Circle]] in [[Emond's Field]].<ref name=comp>[[The Wheel of Time Companion]], Mistress Thane.</ref>

== Activities ==
[[Rand al'Thor]] visits the [[Royal Palace of Andor|Royal Palace]] of [[Caemlyn]] disguised as "Nuli". When he reaches [[Nynaeve al'Meara]], he tells her that Mistress Thane says that Nynaeve to see him right away on Women's Circle business about [[Cenn Buie]], so that he can speak to Nynaeve and [[Lan Mandragoran|Lan]] alone.{{ref/book|9|11}}
